# runtimeconditions.io/x/rc/filesystem

Use this extension when your workload needs a folder from the file system to be there when it starts,
for example a folder for its data, a folder for temporary files, or a folder of configuration files.

In a Condition, you say where the folder must be, and if the workload only reads it or also writes to
it. For a folder that the workload writes to, you also say if the files must still be there after the
workload restarts. You can also say if all copies of the workload must see the same files, and how much
space the folder needs.

The Condition does not say what kind of storage to use. A network file system, a cloud file service or
a local disk can all give the same folder. The platform chooses.

```sh
go get runtimeconditions.io/x/rc/filesystem@v0.2.0
```

Runtime Conditions extension: https://runtimeconditions.io/extensions/rc/file-system/0.2.0/runtimeconditions.extension.yaml

## RcFileSystem

`filesystem.RcFileSystem` declares a `rc.file_system` Condition.

Your workload needs a folder from the file system.

Example: a workload that keeps its media library in /var/lib/media-library. It writes there, the
files must still be there after a restart, and the folder needs at least 10 GiB of space.

```go
filesystem.RcFileSystem(
	filesystem.Mount{
		Access:      filesystem.AccessReadWrite,
		MinimumSize: &[]string{"10Gi"}[0],
		Path:        &[]string{"/var/lib/media-library"}[0],
		Persistence: &[]filesystem.Persistence{filesystem.PersistencePersistent}[0],
	},
)
```

In a Profile, this declares:

```yaml
kind: rc.file_system
interface:
  type: mount
  path: /var/lib/media-library
  access: read_write
  persistence: persistent
  minimumSize: 10Gi
```

## Env

`filesystem.Env` sets the `env` field of `rc.file_system` Conditions with interface type `mount`.

The environment variable that tells your workload where the folder is. Use it when your workload
reads the path from a variable, so the platform can choose where to mount the folder. If you also
give interface.path, that path is the default and the variable can change it.

Example: a workload that reads its credential files from the folder named in CREDENTIALS_DIR.

```go
filesystem.RcFileSystem(
	filesystem.Mount{
		Access: filesystem.AccessReadOnly,
	},
	filesystem.Env{
		filesystem.EnvItem{
			Name:     "CREDENTIALS_DIR",
			Property: filesystem.PropertyPath,
		},
	},
)
```

In a Profile, this declares:

```yaml
kind: rc.file_system
interface:
  type: mount
  access: read_only
env:
  - property: path
    name: CREDENTIALS_DIR
```
